result.topic_en: Gauss records fitted representations of the observations in the Physics Cabinet at the beginning, end and middle of a series, each as a sum of two cosine oscillations with frequencies n and N (7n = 90°, 7N ≈ 30°), with t in seconds counted from 11h 9' 5".

methods.what: Representation of observed readings as a constant plus two superposed harmonic oscillations of different frequencies (harmonic fit)
Specification of the two angular frequencies per 7 seconds
Harmonic representation of the observations at the end of the series
Harmonic representation of the observations in the middle of the series
